OM_HARDWARE_VERSION.title: Mainboard Version
OM_HARDWARE_VERSION.description: Your hardware/firmware version. This corresponds to the mainboard you are using in your build.

OM_MOWER.title: Mower Model
OM_MOWER.description: The type of mower you're using. Mowrator is the supported direct-Pi hardware profile in this fork; YardForce/OpenMower low-level-board profiles are legacy.

ESC_TYPE.title: ESC Type
ESC_TYPE.description: Select which ESC (speed controller) type you are using. Use xesc_mini if unsure.

OM_MOWER_GAMEPAD.title: Gamepad
OM_MOWER_GAMEPAD.description: Select your gamepad. The cheap ones are usually xbox360.

OM_IGNORE_CHARGING_CURRENT.title: Ignore Charging Current
OM_IGNORE_CHARGING_CURRENT.description: Legacy OpenMower low-level-board charging-current workaround. Mowrator batteries are removed for charging and this setting is not used.

DATUM.title: Origin / Datum
DATUM.description: Set the coordinates for the robot's map origin. The only requirement is, that these are near your docking station (within a few meters).

OM_USE_NTRIP.title: Use Ntrip for receiving corrections
OM_USE_NTRIP.description: Set to False if using an external radio.

OM_USE_RTCM_TCP.title: Use raw RTCM over TCP
OM_USE_RTCM_TCP.description: Set to True to read RTCM 3 corrections from a plain TCP socket instead of the built-in NTRIP client.

OM_NTRIP_HOSTNAME.title: NTRIP Hostname
OM_NTRIP_HOSTNAME.description: Hostname or IP of your NTRIP caster.

OM_NTRIP_RECONNECT_WAIT_SECONDS.title: NTRIP Reconnect Wait Seconds
OM_NTRIP_RECONNECT_WAIT_SECONDS.description: How long in seconds the NTRIP client waits before reconnecting

OM_NTRIP_RECONNECT_MAX.title: NTRIP Max Reconnection Attempts
OM_NTRIP_RECONNECT_MAX.description: The maximum number of times the NTRIP client retries

OM_RTCM_TCP_HOSTNAME.title: RTCM TCP Hostname
OM_RTCM_TCP_HOSTNAME.description: Hostname or IP of the raw RTCM 3 TCP stream.

OM_RTCM_TCP_PORT.title: RTCM TCP Port
OM_RTCM_TCP_PORT.description: Port of the raw RTCM 3 TCP stream.

OM_GPS_PROTOCOL.title: GPS Protocol
OM_GPS_PROTOCOL.description: Protocol used by your GPS board. For u-blox devices use UBX, otherwise NMEA.

OM_GPS_DEVICE_TYPE.title: Device Type
OM_GPS_DEVICE_TYPE.description: Whether communicate with the serial port directly or via TCP port.

OM_USE_F9R_SENSOR_FUSION.description: Use F9R's sensor fusion. Disable, if unsure.

OM_USE_RELATIVE_POSITION.title: Use Relative Position
OM_USE_RELATIVE_POSITION.description: True, to use Relative Positioning. If you are unsure keep at false.

OM_GPS_PORT.title: Port
OM_GPS_PORT.description: Port for GPS board (/dev/...). Keep empty for default values.

OM_GPS_TCP_HOSTNAME.title: Hostname
OM_GPS_TCP_HOSTNAME.description: Hostname to read GPS data from via TCP.

OM_GPS_TCP_PORT.title: Port
OM_GPS_TCP_PORT.description: Port to read GPS data from via TCP.

OM_USE_C1_LIDAR.title: Use Slamtec C1 LIDAR
OM_USE_C1_LIDAR.description: Start the optional Slamtec C1 ROS driver and publish LaserScan data for visualization.

OM_C1_SERIAL_PORT.title: C1 serial port
OM_C1_SERIAL_PORT.description: Serial device used by the Slamtec C1.

OM_C1_SERIAL_BAUDRATE.title: C1 serial baudrate
OM_C1_SERIAL_BAUDRATE.description: Serial baudrate used by the Slamtec C1.

OM_C1_FRAME_ID.title: C1 frame id
OM_C1_FRAME_ID.description: TF child frame and LaserScan frame_id for the Slamtec C1.

OM_C1_SCAN_TOPIC.title: C1 scan topic
OM_C1_SCAN_TOPIC.description: ROS topic where C1 LaserScan messages are published.

OM_C1_SCAN_FREQUENCY.title: C1 scan frequency
OM_C1_SCAN_FREQUENCY.description: Requested C1 scan frequency in Hz.

OM_C1_SCAN_MODE.title: C1 scan mode
OM_C1_SCAN_MODE.description: Slamtec scan mode passed to the rplidar_ros driver.

OM_C1_INVERTED.title: C1 inverted
OM_C1_INVERTED.description: Set true if the C1 is mounted inverted and the driver should invert scan angles.

OM_C1_ANGLE_COMPENSATE.title: C1 angle compensation
OM_C1_ANGLE_COMPENSATE.description: Enable angle compensation in the rplidar_ros driver.

OM_C1_X.title: C1 X offset
OM_C1_X.description: C1 x offset from base_link in meters.

OM_C1_Y.title: C1 Y offset
OM_C1_Y.description: C1 y offset from base_link in meters.

OM_C1_Z.title: C1 Z offset
OM_C1_Z.description: C1 z offset from base_link in meters.

OM_C1_ROLL.title: C1 roll
OM_C1_ROLL.description: C1 roll from base_link in radians.

OM_C1_PITCH.title: C1 pitch
OM_C1_PITCH.description: C1 pitch from base_link in radians.

OM_C1_YAW.title: C1 yaw
OM_C1_YAW.description: C1 yaw from base_link in radians.

OM_USE_LSM6DSO_IMU.title: Use LSM6DSO IMU
OM_USE_LSM6DSO_IMU.description: Start the Raspberry Pi I2C LSM6DSO publisher and publish it to /hw/imu/data_raw.

OM_LSM6DSO_I2C_BUS.title: LSM6DSO I2C bus
OM_LSM6DSO_I2C_BUS.description: Raspberry Pi I2C bus number. Header pins 3 and 5 use bus 1.

OM_LSM6DSO_I2C_ADDRESS.title: LSM6DSO I2C address
OM_LSM6DSO_I2C_ADDRESS.description: SparkFun LSM6DSO default address is 0x6B. Use 0x6A if the address jumper is changed.

OM_LSM6DSO_RATE_HZ.title: LSM6DSO publish rate
OM_LSM6DSO_RATE_HZ.description: IMU publish rate in Hz. The current driver configures the sensor for 104 Hz.

OM_LSM6DSO_ACCEL_RANGE_G.title: LSM6DSO accel range
OM_LSM6DSO_ACCEL_RANGE_G.description: Accelerometer full-scale range in g. Supported values: 2, 4, 8, 16.

OM_LSM6DSO_GYRO_RANGE_DPS.title: LSM6DSO gyro range
OM_LSM6DSO_GYRO_RANGE_DPS.description: Gyroscope full-scale range in degrees per second. Supported values: 125, 250, 500, 1000, 2000.

OM_LSM6DSO_AXIS_CONFIG.title: LSM6DSO axis config
OM_LSM6DSO_AXIS_CONFIG.description: Signed sensor-axis mapping into base_link, for example +X+Y+Z or +X-Y-Z. Final value depends on sensor mounting orientation.

OM_DOCKING_DISTANCE.title: Parking Distance
OM_DOCKING_DISTANCE.description: Distance in [m] to drive forward after reaching the recorded parking point.

OM_DOCKING_APPROACH_DISTANCE.title: Parking Approach Distance
OM_DOCKING_APPROACH_DISTANCE.description: Distance in [m] from the recorded docking point to start low-battery parking. Has to be at least the length from the parking point to your nav- or mow-area.

OM_DOCKING_EXTRA_TIME.description: Legacy charger-contact dwell time after voltage detection. Mowrator has no in-mower charging and does not use this.

OM_DOCKING_RETRY_COUNT.title: Parking retry count
OM_DOCKING_RETRY_COUNT.description: How many times to retry parking before giving up.

OM_DOCKING_REDOCK.title: Legacy redocking
OM_DOCKING_REDOCK.description: Legacy charger-contact redock behavior. Mowrator disables automatic redocking.

OM_DOCKING_WAIT_TIME.title: Wait before parking
OM_DOCKING_WAIT_TIME.description: Time to wait (s) at OM_DOCKING_APPROACH_DISTANCE before starting final parking approach.

OM_UNDOCKING_WAIT_TIME.title: Wait before undocking
OM_UNDOCKING_WAIT_TIME.description: Time to wait in dock (s) before before starting to undock

OM_UNDOCK_DISTANCE.title: Undock Distance
OM_UNDOCK_DISTANCE.description: Distance in [m] to drive for undocking.

OM_UNDOCK_ANGLED_DISTANCE.title: Undock Angled Distance
OM_UNDOCK_ANGLED_DISTANCE.description: Distance in [m] to continue driving at an angle for undocking.

OM_UNDOCK_ANGLE.title: Undock Angle
OM_UNDOCK_ANGLE.description: Angle in degrees for second stage undocking.

OM_UNDOCK_FIXED_ANGLE.title: Undock Fixed Angle
OM_UNDOCK_FIXED_ANGLE.description: True to fix the undock angle, false to vary it.

OM_UNDOCK_USE_CURVE.title: Undock Use Curve
OM_UNDOCK_USE_CURVE.description: True to use a curved second stage, false for a straight second stage.

OM_OUTLINE_COUNT.description: How many outlines should the mover drive. It's not recommended to set this below 4.

OM_TOOL_WIDTH.title: Mowing Tool Width
OM_TOOL_WIDTH.description: Width of mowing paths in [m]. Use smaller values for more overlap.

OM_BATTERY_FULL_VOLTAGE.title: Battery Full Voltage
OM_BATTERY_FULL_VOLTAGE.description: Voltage for the removable 56V LiFePO4 battery to be reported as full. Battery voltage is read from the drive ESCs.

OM_BATTERY_EMPTY_VOLTAGE.title: Battery Empty Voltage
OM_BATTERY_EMPTY_VOLTAGE.description: Park if the drive-ESC battery voltage remains below empty for 20s.

OM_BATTERY_CRITICAL_VOLTAGE.title: Battery Critical Voltage
OM_BATTERY_CRITICAL_VOLTAGE.description: Immediately park if the drive-ESC battery voltage is critical. Update this after measuring the battery BMS cutoff and leave margin above that value.

OM_DRIVE_VOLTAGE_MISMATCH_WARN_V.title: Drive voltage mismatch warning
OM_DRIVE_VOLTAGE_MISMATCH_WARN_V.description: Warn if left and right drive ESC battery voltage readings differ by more than this many volts. This warning does not emergency-stop the mower.

OM_MOWING_MOTOR_TEMP_HIGH.title: Mower max. Temperature
OM_MOWING_MOTOR_TEMP_HIGH.description: Motor temperature to stop mowing and wait for cooldown. This value is in deg. C.

OM_MOWING_MOTOR_TEMP_LOW.title: Mower low Temperature
OM_MOWING_MOTOR_TEMP_LOW.description: After reaching the max temperature, mowing will be paused until the mower temperature is above this value. This value is in deg. C.

OM_GPS_WAIT_TIME_SEC.title: GPS Wait Time
OM_GPS_WAIT_TIME_SEC.description: Additional wait time in [s] after undocking. Increase this value, if you get inconsistent fixes after undocking.

OM_GPS_TIMEOUT_SEC.title: GPS Timeout
OM_GPS_TIMEOUT_SEC.description: Timeout for GPS in [s]. Mowing will pause, if no GPS update was received within this configured time.

OM_ENABLE_MOWER.title: Enable Mowing Motor
OM_ENABLE_MOWER.description: Enable mowing motor. Set to false for testing.

OM_RANDOMIZE_MOWER_DIRECTION.title: Randomize Mower Direction
OM_RANDOMIZE_MOWER_DIRECTION.description: Alternate mower start direction on enable. Leave this disabled unless you explicitly want alternating blade rotation.

OM_OUTLINE_OFFSET.title: Mowing Outline Offset
OM_OUTLINE_OFFSET.description: Offset to be applied to the recorded outline. Positive values move the outline inwards (i.e. safety margin).

OM_ENABLE_RECORDING_ALL.title: Enable Recording
OM_ENABLE_RECORDING_ALL.description: Set to true to record your session for debugging. Recordings will be stored in $HOME. Only enable for testing, otherwise your SD card will get full soon.

OM_NO_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_LOG.title: Disable Battery Voltage Log
OM_NO_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_LOG.description: Set to true to disable the Mowrator CSV battery voltage logger. The logger is enabled by default and runs as a separate process from the hardware bridge.

OM_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_LOG_PATH.title: Battery Voltage Log Path
OM_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_LOG_PATH.description: Optional CSV path for the Mowrator battery voltage logger. Empty uses ROS_HOME or ~/.ros/battery_voltage_log.csv so the plain-Pi workflow keeps the file across container restarts.

OM_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_LOG_PERIOD_SEC.title: Battery Voltage Log Period
OM_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_LOG_PERIOD_SEC.description: Seconds between CSV samples. Each row records the battery voltage reported by the left drive, right drive, and mower/blade ESC.

OM_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_LOG_FSYNC.title: Battery Voltage Log Fsync
OM_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_LOG_FSYNC.description: Flush and fsync every CSV row so the most recent battery samples are likely to survive sudden BMS power cutoff. The logger runs outside the mower control loop.

OM_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_LOG_MAX_BYTES.title: Battery Voltage Log Max Bytes
OM_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_LOG_MAX_BYTES.description: Maximum size for the active battery voltage CSV before rotation. Set 0 to disable rotation.

OM_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_LOG_MAX_FILES.title: Battery Voltage Log Max Files
OM_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_LOG_MAX_FILES.description: Maximum number of battery voltage CSV files to keep, including the active file. With the default max bytes this caps the log set at about 50 MiB.

OM_SNAPSHOT_MEMORY_PER_TOPIC.title: Snapshot Buffer Memory per Topic
OM_SNAPSHOT_MEMORY_PER_TOPIC.description: Sets the maximum memory used per topic (in MB) by the Snapshot Buffer. The Snapshot Buffer stores a recent history of all messages sent, and can be dumped to disk using save_snapshot.sh. It is independent of OM_ENABLE_RECORDING

OM_SNAPSHOT_DURATION.title: Snapshot Buffer
OM_SNAPSHOT_DURATION.description: Sets the maximum age (in seconds) of messages to store in the Snapshot Buffer. The Snapshot Buffer stores a recent history of all messages sent, and can be dumped to disk using save_snapshot.sh. It is independent of OM_ENABLE_RECORDING

OM_RAIN_MODE.title: Rain Mode
OM_RAIN_MODE.description: Legacy low-level-board rain behavior. The Mowrator runtime has no rain sensor and ignores rain decisions.

OM_RAIN_DELAY_MINUTES.title: Rain delay minutes
OM_RAIN_DELAY_MINUTES.description: Legacy low-level-board rain delay. The Mowrator runtime has no rain sensor.

OM_MOWING_ANGLE_OFFSET.description: Mowing angle offset -180 deg - +180 deg, 0 = east, -90 = north. If mowing angle offset is not absolute it gets added to the auto detected angle which is set by the first 2 m of recorded outline.

OM_MOWING_ANGLE_OFFSET_IS_ABSOLUTE.description: If mowing angle offset is absolute.

OM_MOWING_ANGLE_INCREMENT.description: The increment value will automatically add specified number of degrees to the mowing angle everytime the whole map is finished

OM_PERIMETER_SIGNAL.description: Legacy perimeter docking sensor. The Mowrator runtime parks at the recorded docking point without charger or perimeter detection.

OM_EMERGENCY_INPUT_CONFIG.description: Legacy low-level-board emergency input list. The Mowrator runtime has no low-level-board stop/lift/tilt inputs.

OM_EMERGENCY_LIFT_PERIOD.description: Legacy low-level-board lift filter. The Mowrator runtime has no low-level-board lift input.

OM_EMERGENCY_TILT_PERIOD.description: Legacy low-level-board tilt/lift filter. The Mowrator runtime has no low-level-board tilt input.

OM_SHUTDOWN_ESC_MAX_PITCH.description: Maximum pitch angle (deg) where ESC shutdown is permitted (0 to disable ESC shutdown)

OM_CU_RAIN_THRESHOLD.title: Stock-CoverUI rain sensor threshold
OM_CU_RAIN_THRESHOLD.description: Legacy Stock-CoverUI rain threshold. The Mowrator runtime has no rain sensor.

OM_BATTERY_CRITICAL_HIGH_VOLTAGE.title: Legacy max battery voltage
OM_BATTERY_CRITICAL_HIGH_VOLTAGE.description: Legacy OpenMower low-level-board charging limit. Not used by the Mowrator removable-battery runtime.

OM_CHARGE_CRITICAL_HIGH_VOLTAGE.title: Legacy max charge voltage
OM_CHARGE_CRITICAL_HIGH_VOLTAGE.description: Legacy OpenMower low-level-board charging limit. Not used by the Mowrator removable-battery runtime.

OM_CHARGE_CRITICAL_HIGH_CURRENT.title: Legacy max charge current
OM_CHARGE_CRITICAL_HIGH_CURRENT.description: Legacy OpenMower low-level-board charging limit. Not used by the Mowrator removable-battery runtime.

external_mqtt_broker.title: External MQTT Broker
external_mqtt_broker.description: You can configure Open Mower to publish status and sensor data to your MQTT broker.

OM_MQTT_ENABLE.title: Enable MQTT Publisher
OM_MQTT_ENABLE.description: Enable publishing to the external MQTT broker.

OM_MQTT_HOSTNAME.title: MQTT Broker Hostname
OM_MQTT_HOSTNAME.description: MQTT broker hostname or IP address.

sound_settings.title: Sound Settings
sound_settings.description: For Full Sound Support read the instructions carefully. You will probably need to make hardware modifications before enabling these options.

OM_DFP_IS_5V.title: DFPlayer is set to 5V
OM_DFP_IS_5V.description: Enable if DFPlayer is set to 5V. Important: ONLY enable this, if you are sure that you have done the required modification. Otherwise you might break your Raspberry Pi Pico.

OM_LANGUAGE.description: Language as ISO-639-1 code string. This is use for sound output.

OM_VOLUME.description: Sound volume (0-100 or -1). -1 means the volume is managed by the CoverUI.

OM_BACKGROUND_SOUNDS.title: Also play background sounds
OM_BACKGROUND_SOUNDS.description: Enable if DFPlayer shall also play background-sounds (beside the informational advert sounds)

custom_environment.title: Additional Environment Variables
custom_environment.description: Click the + button to add additional environment variables. Each row is a KEY=VALUE pair and will be injected into the container.
